title: On Control of Drawdown: Robust Invariance and Optimality
abstract: arXiv:2609.23272v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mitigating \emph{drawdown}, the decline in wealth from its running peak, presents a canonical problem in path-dependent risk control. In this paper, we develop a finite-horizon control framework that enforces a prescribed maximum percentage drawdown limit in multi-asset stochastic systems. Our first result is an exact robust-invariance theorem characterizing every control action that preserves a prescribed drawdown limit against all supported returns. We show that every robustly safe control admits a \emph{drawdown-modulated} form: the product of the current drawdown \emph{cushion} and a feasible \emph{normalized direction}. This yields a complete parameterization of robustly drawdown-safe policies. Additionally, under stagewise-independent returns, we show that optimizing over all robustly safe causal policies reduces to a one-dimensional Bellman recursion and yields an optimal robustly safe state-feedback policy. translated_title: 论回撤控制：鲁棒不变性与最优性
translated_abstract: 缓解回撤（即财富从其历史峰值的下降）是路径依赖风险控制中的一个经典问题。本文针对多资产随机系统，开发了一个有限时域控制框架，用以强制执行预设的最大百分比回撤限制。我们的第一个结果是一个精确的鲁棒不变性定理，刻画了在所有支持的收益情形下能够保持预设回撤限制的每一个控制动作。我们证明，每一个鲁棒安全的控制都具有“回撤调制”形式：即当前回撤缓冲与一个可行的归一化方向的乘积。由此得到了鲁棒回撤安全策略的完整参数化。此外，在收益逐阶段独立的条件下，我们证明了对所有鲁棒安全因果策略的优化可简化为一个一维贝尔曼递归，并由此得到最优的鲁棒安全状态反馈策略。最后，我们刻画……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一个多资产随机系统下的有限时域回撤控制框架，精确刻画了所有能保证预设最大回撤限制的鲁棒安全控制（均具有“回撤缓冲×归一化方向”的回撤调制形式），并证明最优鲁棒安全策略可通过一维贝尔曼递归求解。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a finite-horizon control framework for multi-asset stochastic systems that exactly characterizes all robustly drawdown-safe controls via a drawdown-modulated form (cushion times normalized direction) and shows the optimal robustly safe state-feedback policy reduces to a one-dimensional Bellman recursion.
